specification.status: DRAFT; register with init before replay
specification.scope: E.9 fixed proposal sets and original within-fit checkpoints; retrospective exposed-test analysis
specification.baseline: D00 plus exactly the valid candidates in each original sealed trace; never union modes or add unqueried candidates
specification.lab_evidence: Ten selected-checkpoint development primaries labelled target:0 through target:9; delta_l(c)=score_l(c)-score_l(D00)

rules.median: Maximize median(delta_l), then lower original pooled BCE
rules.lcb1: Maximize mean(delta_l)-sample_SD(delta_l)/sqrt(10), then lower original pooled BCE; k=1 fixed
rules.majority6: Eligible iff D00, or pooled primary improves by >1e-12 and >=6/10 lab deltas exceed 1e-12; among eligible maximize original pooled primary then lower BCE

specification.ties: Complete key ties keep earliest candidate in original encounter order; D00 first
specification.undefined_labs: No lab or seed deletion and no zero imputation; stop as incomplete if any required lab primary is undefined
specification.checkpoint_rule: Unchanged pooled primary/loss selection among rounds 2/5/10/20; only final candidate selection changes
specification.primary: Separately per task: Qwen structured lcb1 minus original pooled-selection Qwen structured held-out score
secondary: All three rules minus original pooled selection for every proposer/task/mode
Per-seed switches, wins/ties/losses, development gains and dispersion
specification.references: Original exact-random, Luna and GP results remain contextual references. Original random weights must not be interpreted as weights under robust selection.

bootstrap.unit: Eight paired whole seed blocks; same resamples across contrasts

specification.inference: No endpoint or proposer pooling. Secondary rule comparisons cannot be used to choose a winner. No tuning after rescoring.

cost.heldout: Hash-check and independently rescore saved predictions using the original scorer

specification.gate: Seal all rule selections for all 160 proposer/task/seed/mode cells before opening held-out scores or predictions
limitations: Laboratories are shards of fixed development populations; lcb1 is a dispersion penalty, not a calibrated confidence bound
Within-fit checkpoint selection already used all labs; this replay does not create independent confirmation panels
E.3 already contains a related incumbent-rule replay; legacy E.3/E.8 extensions require detailed server evidence and a separate locked manifest
specification.failures: No exclusions or replacement seeds; missing evidence leaves analysis incomplete
